hero.title: Our Story: Three Generations of Cashew Excellence in Ivory Coast
hero.subtitle: From family farm to global exporter — AfriNuts Export is redefining Ivory Coast's cashew industry through vertical integration, organic farming, and community investment.

ceo.title: A Message From Our CEO
message: At AfriNuts Export, our journey is deeply personal, rooted in family, faith, and Odienné, in the heart of Côte d’Ivoire — the world’s largest cashew-producing nation. What began as my grandfather’s work in the fields has become a three-generation legacy, and today, we are transforming that legacy into a global vision for the future of the cashew industry.

We are building more than a business — we are building a vertically integrated value chain designed to redefine how African agricultural products reach the world. From cultivation to processing, packaging, and export, every step is controlled with precision, ensuring quality, traceability, and accountability for our global partners.

Our ambition is clear: to move beyond raw commodity exports and establish Côte d’Ivoire as a leader in finished, branded agricultural products. The cashew should not leave Africa as a raw material — it should reach international markets as a premium, value-added product that reflects the excellence of its origin.

At the core of this vision is impact. We invest in farmer training, youth employment, and sustainable agricultural practices that protect the land for future generations. Through our profit-sharing initiatives, we contribute to building wells, supporting schools, and strengthening communities — because true success is measured by the value we create for others.

We are developing our 35-hectare farm in Odienné as a model for regenerative agriculture and long-term sustainability. With future plans for a modern processing facility, AfriNuts is positioned to become a hub for innovation, job creation, and international trade in West Africa.

Our commitment to transparency, ethical sourcing, and trust is grounded in both global business standards and our Islamic values. These principles guide every partnership we form and every product we deliver.

To our partners, customers, and investors: this is an invitation to be part of a new chapter in African enterprise — one defined not by extraction, but by value creation, dignity, and long-term vision.

With Allah’s guidance and the strength of our team, we are building a company that will carry the story of Odienné from local fields to global markets — setting a new standard for what African agriculture can achieve.

cfo.title: Message from Our COO
cfo.position: Co-Founder | Chief Financial & Operating Officer (CFO & COO)
message: At AfriNuts Export, our financial strategy is grounded in growth with responsibility, and innovation with integrity. Representing three generations of cashew farming, we’ve inherited more than land, we’ve inherited a legacy of trust, a commitment to our communities, and a duty to steward our resources with transparency and justice.

As CFO, I oversee a financial framework that is not solely driven by profit, but by the principle that growth must be shared. Our approach aligns with Islamic financial ethics, prioritizing profit-sharing, social impact, and long-term reinvestment in the very people and places that power our business.

We reject extractive business models. That’s why we’re transitioning from raw cashew export to in-country processing, creating jobs, building infrastructure, and adding value within Côte d’Ivoire. Every financial decision supports our broader vision: a vertically integrated cashew value chain that delivers world-class quality while uplifting local communities.

I ensure fiscal discipline, strategic investment, and complete transparency across all operations. From training farmers, to promoting sustainable agriculture, to developing a state-of-the-art processing facility in Odienné, our financial priorities serve both regional empowerment and global excellence.
AfriNuts is more than a company. We are a movement for African agricultural sovereignty, and we invite all partners who believe in a future that is as ethical as it is profitable.

brand.title: Our Commitment to Premium Organic Cashews from Ivory Coast
brand.text: Located in the heart of the world's largest cashew-producing nation, Côte d'Ivoire, AfriNuts Export delivers premium Ivory Coast cashews through sustainable farming and meticulous processing. We combine West Africa's agricultural heritage with international quality standards to meet growing global demand for traceable, responsibly-sourced products.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To produce premium cashew products through sustainable farming, rigorous quality control, and equitable partnerships with local growers.

values.title: Our Values
values.text: Quality, Sustainability, Community Partnership, and Innovation guide every aspect of our operations.

community.title: 10% of Our Profits Go Back to the Community

pledge.title: 10% Reinvestment Pledge
pledge.text: We allocate 10% of annual net profit from our 35-hectare farm to local development. First projects include a water well and community school in Odienné.

water.title: Water Access Initiative
water.text: Drilling boreholes and installing water purification systems for farming communities in our operational areas.

religion.title: Community Infrastructure
religion.text: Supporting the construction and maintenance of mosques, madrasas, and essential community institutions.

farm.title: Our 35-Hectare Organic Cashew Farm in Odienné, Ivory Coast
farm.subtitle: OUR OPERATIONS
farm.text: At the heart of Ivory Coast's cashew belt lies our family farm — 35 hectares of prime agricultural land with over 3,500 cashew trees planted. We use organic farming methods, no synthetic pesticides, and sustainable water management.
